description: Morphe patches for BitChord 1.8.1: music from your own Telegram channels, download-only Soulseek audio, and optional playback tools. Runs on your phone using your own accounts; doesn't unlock premium features.

patches.name: Battery saver
patches.description: Lets the phone's audio chip decode songs, so long listens use less battery. BitChord's effects don't run on songs played this way. Settings are in Settings, Tweaks & patches.

patches.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

options.description: The app name on your home screen, up to 80 characters. Leave blank for Bitchord+. A name containing Telegram must include Unofficial Telegram.

patches.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Tweaks & patches.

patches.name: Loudness level
patches.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Tweaks & patches.

patches.name: Pitch control
patches.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Tweaks & patches.

patches.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches.name: Sing
patches.description: Turns the lead vocal down so you can sing over the song. Ported from the vocal remover in Auris by OreoMuncher45, a fork of BitChord. Settings are in Settings, Tweaks & patches.

patches.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches.description: Fades the song out over 10 seconds before the sleep timer pauses it. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Tweaks & patches.

patches.name: Unofficial Soulseek audio
patches.description: Download selected Soulseek or debrid audio to a phone folder, a configured Telegram main channel, or both. Optional debrid services use your own API keys. Choose accepted formats and their order in setup. Live playback and automatic source matching are disabled. Android 8 or newer.

patches.name: Unofficial Telegram music
patches.description: Search and play audio from your own Telegram channels, right on your phone. Android 8 or newer.

options.description: Leave at 0 and enter your API ID in the app after installing.
Leave empty and enter your API hash in the app after installing.

release_notes:
# 1.1.0-beta.5

First-time download setup now asks where copies go: a phone folder, the user's
configured private Telegram main channel, or both. Users choose enabled audio
formats and arrange their preference order. Downloads retain the settings chosen
when they were queued and validate the completed file's encoding before saving.

The optional Soulseek patch remains download-only. Paired phones can explicitly
share selected files through encrypted Nostr coordination, direct UDP/QUIC, and
available I2P, Tor or IPFS fallback routes. Verified chunks and independent copy
receipts support recovery without silently substituting another recording.

Optional Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize and TorBox link downloads are included
in this same build. Each service is independently enabled, starts off,
and uses the user's own protected API key. A chosen service resolves a supplied
HTTPS link or magnet; selected audio files use the saved Phone, Telegram main
channel or Both destination. These services do not provide a music catalogue or
automatic paid-provider fallback. See [debrid setup](https://github.com/Hexclyde/bitchord-morphe-patches/blob/3abaad00d5ca329c93420575e9d3effc1695aff4/docs/DEBRID.md).

The new runtime libraries are included for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 on
Android 8 or newer. This is a testing build for BitChord 1.8.1. Local checks pass;
public-network operation and the new workflows still need real-phone testing.
Provider fixtures do not establish live debrid account access or queue behavior.
Collection-level album/playlist integration remains pending. Ordinary Soulseek
clients do not gain the paired-phone overlay protocol automatically.
